What is entrepreneurial skills

Last week, Jacob was invited by the Youth Entrepreneurship Forum to teach on business management skills. As a form one student with goods knowledge about business studies, with four points advise him on the skills that he should teach

questions.answerKey: Entrepreneurial skills are abilities that help a person identify and pursue opportunities and manage an enterprise. Jacob can teach financial management (budgeting and controlling funds); sales and marketing (understanding and reaching customers); decision making (comparing choices and acting on evidence); and negotiation (reaching workable agreements).
questions.markingGuide: Source scheme: definition 3 marks plus four business-management skills at 3 marks each, total 15.
